rooms.name: Lychgate
rooms.description: The roofed gate of Solomon's Rest. The iron scrollwork spells a square and compasses, and the padlock your friends clicked shut behind you is still warm.

rooms.name: Gravel Path
rooms.description: A ribbon of white gravel between leaning rows of slate. Your footsteps sound much louder than they should.

rooms.name: Caretakers Lodge
rooms.description: A one-room stone lodge, door ajar. A kettle sits on a cold stove, and a coat hangs by the door as if its owner means to return.

rooms.name: Toolshed
rooms.description: A lean-to of tar-papered boards. Rakes, twine, and grave-digging tools hang in orderly silhouettes.

rooms.name: Chapel of the Compasses
rooms.description: A small lodge chapel. Votive candles gutter beneath a wall of mason's marks, and a figure in an old-fashioned coat stands guard at the inner door — through you, the candlelight passes him entirely.

rooms.name: Undercroft
rooms.description: A vaulted cellar beneath the chapel, black and bone-dry. Whatever the lodge kept down here, they kept it locked.

rooms.name: Old Yard
rooms.description: The oldest graves, their inscriptions worn to braille. A wrought-iron fence sags around a family plot, spikes loose in their sockets.

rooms.name: Potters Field
rooms.description: Unmarked mounds under thistle. Something small and masked rummages in the leaf litter.

rooms.name: Widows Willow
rooms.description: A great willow weeps over a single white stone. A woman in mourning gray stands beneath it — she has been standing there a very long time.

rooms.name: Mausoleum Row
rooms.description: A street of little stone houses for the dead. One bronze door at the row's end is newer than the rest, and something inside one of the crypts is breathing.

rooms.name: Founders Mausoleum
rooms.description: The founder's vault. A marble sarcophagus, a wall of lodge regalia — and a long oak case with brass hinges, the kind made for things that fire.

rooms.name: Columbarium
rooms.description: Walls of little brass-doored niches, urn after urn. A few doors hang open, ash spilled like spent hourglasses.

rooms.name: Ossuary
rooms.description: A half-sunken vault stacked with folded bones. The femurs are sorted by length. Someone was very patient.

rooms.name: Charnel House
rooms.description: A windowless outbuilding that smells of quicklime and old earth. The workbench is stained in ways a workbench should not be.

rooms.name: Obelisk Circle
rooms.description: Nine granite obelisks in a ring, each carved with an all-seeing eye. Standing in the center, you are certain all nine are looking at you.

rooms.name: Yew Alley
rooms.description: A corridor of black yews clipped into walls. The dark between their trunks is total, and now and then it shifts.

rooms.name: Reflecting Pool
rooms.description: A long, still pool skinned with leaves. The reflections in it are a half-second behind, and one of them is not yours.

rooms.name: Bone Hollow
rooms.description: A sunken dell where the ground has settled over something. Fog pools here knee-deep, and the grass grows in rib-shaped rows.

loot.name: abandoned-backpack
loot.description: Somebody's backpack, dropped at the gate. Whoever dared whoever, they left in a hurry.

loot.name: votive-shelf
loot.description: A shelf of candles and one long processional torch, pitch-headed and ready.

loot.name: iron-fence
loot.description: The sagging plot fence. One decorative spike lifts free with a squeal.

loot.name: fallen-marker
loot.description: A toppled wooden grave marker, weathered to a club's heft.

loot.name: yew-gate
loot.description: A rusted side-gate wedged into the yews, its finial spike loose.

loot.name: open-niche
loot.description: A niche whose brass door hangs open. Inside, wrapped in velvet, lies a ceremonial trowel — lodge silver, cold as a promise.

loot.name: lime-bench
loot.description: The stained workbench. Beneath it, wrapped in oilcloth and shoved deep against the wall, something with an edge.

loot.name: sunken-reliquary
loot.description: A little tin reliquary tucked between femurs.

loot.name: offering-bowl
loot.description: A stone bowl at the circle's center, where someone still leaves offerings.

loot.name: drowned-lockbox
loot.description: A rusted lockbox lying in the shallows, lid sprung.

loot.name: undercroft-cache
loot.description: A lodge storage chest, banded in iron. The masons kept their working tools sharp.

loot.name: founders-gun-case
loot.description: The long oak case, velvet-lined: the founder was buried with his sidearm — and with a ledger he perhaps meant no one to read.

narration.text: Gray light crests the yews, and the birdsong is suddenly, absurdly ordinary. Down the rows a lantern gutters out, a spade is shouldered, and the Sexton goes below without a backward glance. The lychgate stands open. Whoever is still on their feet walks out of Solomon's Rest — and nobody ever takes the dare again.

The last of you goes down, and the yard falls quiet. Unhurried footsteps. The scrape of a spade. The Sexton works until the sky pales, and by morning Solomon's Rest has four new mounds, unmarked, dug together — because even now, he keeps you together.

timeoutNarration.text: The bell tolls an hour no clock owns. You count them: thirteen. Dawn is not coming — not for you, not ever — and somewhere among the stones the Sexton begins, unhurried, to dig four new graves.
